title: US Senate votes to include CBDC ban in bipartisan housing bill
summary: The provision banning the Federal Reserve from issuing a central bank digital currency was included in housing affordability legislation.

title: Binance claims ‘full and complete legal victory‘ in Alabama court
summary: While a judge granted a motion by Changpeng Zhao, he also ordered the plaintiffs in the case against Binance to file a second complaint or face ”total or partial dismissal.”

title: Polychain backs VeryAI’s $10M raise to build palm-scan identity system on Solana
summary: The startup’s smartphone-based biometric system aims to help crypto platforms detect AI-generated accounts while preserving user privacy through onchain verification.

title: Bitcoin funding rate flips negative: Are bears getting too confident?
summary: While geopolitical tension and weak labor data are hurting market sentiment, institutional buying below $75,000 may soon exhaust sellers and spark a bull run.

title: Coinbase execs deny lobbying against Bitcoin de minimis tax exemption
summary: US lawmakers are eyeing tax exemptions for US dollar stablecoins, which are pegged and do not change in value, but not other cryptocurrencies.

title: Crypto accounting startup Cryptio lands $45M as institutions move onchain
summary: A surge in tokenized finance is driving demand for systems that reconcile blockchain transactions for audits and reporting, pushing digital asset accounting into focus.

title: Is Bitcoin price at risk if private credit breaks?
summary: A looming private credit crisis risked triggering liquidity crunches that could initially suppress Bitcoin prices, but Fed interventions may ignite a major BTC rally.

title: Tether joins $5.2M round in stablecoin infrastructure builder Ark Labs
summary: The funding will support development of a programmable execution layer designed to enable faster issuance and settlement of digital assets on the network.

title: CFTC chair opens prediction markets rulemaking to public comment
summary: “This ends today,“ said CFTC Chair Michael Selig, who has been reiterating his position that the agency has exclusive jurisdiction overseeing prediction markets platforms.

title: Bitcoin catching up to gold hints at an ‘opportunity within risk’
summary: Bitcoin showed early signs of overtaking gold in the market as new data outlined an opportunity based on historical returns around the US midterm elections.
